messages:
Rina: Quick sync  planning a short series: "Snack Tutorials" (30-45 min) to drive OSS refapp adoption. Need a micro-launch plan for the first tutorial: launch post, social, tiny benchmark highlight, CTA to try repo.
Ethan: I'll craft a 3-line bench stat for social: e.g., \"Refapp reduces p95 by ~20% with cache on\". Need numbers to nail it.
Harper: I'll do the launch post and 2 email variants (developer vs platform lead). Keep the developer email code-first and the platform lead email results-first.
Sam: I'll build the registration page and set up routing: small companies -> automated onboarding, mid-market -> growth SDR, enterprise -> AE. Also will create HubSpot list "snack-tutorial-1".
Rina: Keep the cohort < 80 so it's interactive. Also add a free extra office hours slot for top 5 qualifying companies.
ops-bot: Event created: "Snack Tutorial #1: OSS Refapp Quickstart" on Apr 12.
Ethan: I can produce a 1-slide bench summary and a 1-paragraph blurb for the post.
Harper: Draft launch post: "Snack Tutorial: Deploy a refapp in 30 minutes + performance tips." Short social: "30-min live: deploy a refapp + bench walk. Register: [link]".
Sam: Routing detail: HubSpot property set -> source=snack-tutorial-1, tag=snack-series. Also capture consent for marketing.
Rina: Also ask registrants if they want a follow-up demo; that's our lead signal. Use interest_level field (none/try/demo/pilot).
Ethan: Bench request: run 100 runs of 512-token prompts baseline vs cache+batching. I'll generate a chart and push to assets.
Harper: Post + emails to be ready by Apr 3. Social schedule: tease Apr 5, registration opens Apr 6, reminders Apr 10 & Apr 11.
Sam: Will share the form link when ready. Also will add GTM tags for UTM tracking.
Rina: Great. Harper, please A/B subject lines: (1) "Try the refapp in 30 minutes" (2) "Cut inference latency with caching".
Harper: Doing that. Also drafting a plain-text follow-up for the registration confirmation with a short checklist.
ops-bot: Reminder: "Publish social teaser" scheduled for Apr 5.
Rina: Assign owners: Ethan = bench blurb & slide, Harper = copy & email, Sam = form & routing. I'll manage calendar invites and office hours.
Harper: Posting draft here later today for review.
Ethan: Will have bench PNG by tomorrow.
Sam: Form live link: https://forms.redwood.com/snack1 (WIP)
Rina: Closing for now. Ping if blockers. :white_check_mark:
